title: EvidenceRequest (coresearcher.evidence/v1)
description: What a client (EdiTXT) asks CoResearcher about. CoResearcher answers with an EvidenceGraph built only from what it holds (ADR-DISCOVERY-067).

request_id.description: Optional client id. When absent, the server derives one from the graph digest.

hypothesis.description: A formal hypothesis object, as accepted by POST /api/hypotheses/evaluate. Optional premise_provenance maps each assumption to {origin: SUPPLIED | LITERATURE | PERSON | SYSTEM | UNDECLARED, tested_against_data: boolean, source: string}. It is reported on the assumption nodes and never changes a verdict.

consequences.description: FORMAL_HYPOTHESIS only: expressions to check for entailment.

rivals.description: FORMAL_HYPOTHESIS only: rival hypotheses to compare against, with discriminating states.

claim_ids.description: Ids of the manuscript claims the client links to this target (for example EdiTXT's CLM-001).
